blind_raw_settings._comment: Only required if input file is .raw (binary stream)

color_management._comment_modes: Use 'none' if Raw->PNG (Visual). Use 'srgb_to_linear' if Raw->EXR (Data). Use 'linear_to_srgb' if EXR->PNG.

tone_mapping._comment: Enable this if converting EXR/HDR (Linear) to PNG/JPG (Standard) to prevent clipping.
